Mantellian Savrips are often brutes with little interest in the affairs of others. After their near extermination on
, most Mantellian Savrips have become withdrawn from galactic society, rarely leaving their villages in the Scraplands.

Mantellian Savrips have a hunched-over stature, leathery skin, snake-like heads, and arms long enough to drag the ground. Their skin tone can vary between a bland grey or a dark blue tone, and their mouths are filled with razor-sharp poisonous teeth. A typical Mantellian Savrip stands 4.0 meters tall and weighs 250 kilograms.
